tasks.title: Conversation #83
tasks.transcript:
Man:This is Jimmy Clarkin from Rise Bakery calling.I received a message that you'd like to do a story about my shop for your university newspaper.
Woman: Yes, you've been a staple in our city for generations now. The grandparents of our current students were customers there when they were young
Man: It's a family owned business and we're proud of it. Would you be able to come next Monday at 3 o'clock?
Woman: Definitely. Is it all right if my photographer comes along?
Man:Of course you can get different shots even back in our kitchen where we do all the baking.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the bakery?

options.B: It has been in business for a long time.
options.D: Students receive a discount on their purchases.

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：关于这家面包店，可以推断出什么？ 定位原文：Woman: Yes, you've been a staple in our city for generations now. The grandparents of our current students were customers there when they were young. 选项分析： A. It sells unique products. 它出售独特的产品。虽然可能产品不错，但对话中强调的是其历史悠久，并未着重描述产品的独特性，所以A选项错误。 B. It has been in business for a long time. 它已经经营很长时间了。由于女士提到这家店是城市里几代人的主要店铺，甚至现在学生的祖父母年轻时就是顾客，这直接暗示了其经营时间非常长，所以B选项正确。 C. The owner recently purchased it. 店主最近买下了它。因为男士明确说这是家族企业并为此感到自豪，且女士提到经营了几代人，说明不是最近购买的，所以C选项错误。 D. Students receive a discount on their purchases. 学生购物有折扣。对话中完全没有提到学生是否有折扣，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: Based on the conversation, what will happen during the interview?

options.B: The kitchen will be temporarily closed.
options.C: The woman will speak with some customers.
options.D: The man will provide some bakery items to try.

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：基于对话，采访期间会发生什么？ 定位原文：Woman: Definitely. Is it all right if my photographer comes along? Man: Of course you can get different shots even back in our kitchen where we do all the baking. 选项分析： A. Pictures will be taken. 将会拍照。由于女士询问摄影师是否可以同行，男士表示同意并说可以去厨房拍摄，这说明确实会进行拍照，所以A选项正确。 B. The kitchen will be temporarily closed. 厨房将暂时关闭。因为男士只是邀请他们去厨房拍照，并没有说为了采访要关闭厨房停止营业，所以B选项错误。 C. The woman will speak with some customers. 女士将与一些顾客交谈。对话中只提到了店主和摄影师，并未提及会采访顾客，所以C选项错误。 D. The man will provide some bakery items to try. 男士将提供一些面包店食品供品尝。虽然这是面包店，但对话中只确认了拍照的事宜，并没有明确提到会提供食物试吃，所以D选项错误。
